welcome.title: Welcome to Open Meeting
welcome.content: Let's take a quick tour of every section available to you. You can skip at any time and replay this tour from Account Settings.

parkSelect.title: Site Selector
parkSelect.content: Switch between parks (sites) here. As Super Admin you can manage all sites from one account. The data shown on every page reflects the selected site.

calendarSuperAdmin.title: Calendar
calendarSuperAdmin.content: The visual weekly calendar shows every room's availability side-by-side. Click any open slot to create a booking. Past bookings remain visible for the full current week.

calendarParkAdmin.title: Calendar
calendarParkAdmin.content: The visual weekly calendar shows every room's availability side-by-side. Click any open slot to create a booking. You can also view and manage any booking on behalf of users.

calendarCompanyAdmin.title: Calendar
calendarCompanyAdmin.content: The visual weekly calendar shows every available room side-by-side. Click any open slot to book a room for your team. The system prevents double-bookings automatically.

calendarReceptionist.title: Calendar
calendarReceptionist.content: The weekly calendar shows all room bookings. Use it to see which meetings are happening now and which rooms are available.

calendarUser.title: Book a Room
calendarUser.content: The weekly calendar shows all rooms side-by-side. Green slots are free, red slots are booked. Click any open slot to create a booking — conflicts are prevented automatically.

roomsSuperAdmin.title: Rooms
roomsSuperAdmin.content: Browse the full list of meeting rooms. Filter by capacity and amenities to find the right space, then click a room to see its schedule and book directly.

roomsParkAdmin.title: Rooms
roomsParkAdmin.content: Browse all meeting rooms in your site. Filter by capacity and amenities, view room details and current availability.

roomsCompanyAdmin.title: Rooms
roomsCompanyAdmin.content: Browse available meeting rooms. Filter by capacity and amenities to find the right space, then book directly from the room detail view.

roomsReceptionist.title: Rooms
roomsReceptionist.content: Browse all meeting rooms, view their amenities and current availability.

roomsUser.title: Browse Rooms
roomsUser.content: Filter rooms by capacity and amenities to find the right space for your meeting. Click a room to see its full schedule and book directly from there.

hotDesks.title: Hot Desks
hotDesks.content: Book a hot desk for a single day, a date range, or pick multiple individual days. Filter by features like standing desk or dual monitor, and track your monthly quota.

myBookingsSuperAdmin.title: My Bookings
myBookingsSuperAdmin.content: A list of all your own upcoming and past bookings. Cancel meetings, view attendee details, or check the room assigned to each booking.

myBookingsUser.title: My Bookings
myBookingsUser.content: All your upcoming and past bookings in one place. Cancel a meeting, see who else is attending, or check which room is assigned.

myBookingsReceptionist.title: My Bookings
myBookingsReceptionist.content: A list of all your own bookings. Cancel meetings or review details from here.

users.title: Users
users.content: Invite new users by email and assign them a role. View and edit existing accounts, reset two-factor authentication, and resend pending invite links.

usersParkAdmin.title: Users
usersParkAdmin.content: Invite new users by email and assign them a role within your site. Edit accounts, reset two-factor authentication, and resend pending invite links.

usersCompanyAdmin.title: Users
usersCompanyAdmin.content: Invite team members by email and assign them a role (User, Company Admin, or Receptionist). Edit existing accounts and resend invite links for pending users.

manageRooms.title: Manage Rooms
manageRooms.content: Create and configure meeting rooms — set capacity, floor, amenities, per-room opening/closing hours, company access restrictions, and IoT display booking durations.

manageRoomsParkAdmin.title: Manage Rooms
manageRoomsParkAdmin.content: Create and configure meeting rooms — set capacity, floor, amenities, per-room opening/closing hours, company access restrictions, quick-booking durations, and optional email-based booking (iMIP).

manageDesks.title: Manage Desks
manageDesks.content: Create and manage hot desks, set monthly booking quotas per user or per company, control which companies have access, and set individual quota overrides.

devices.title: Devices
devices.content: Manage ESP32 room display devices. Monitor online status and last-seen timestamps, push over-the-air firmware updates, and regenerate device security tokens.

devicesParkAdmin.title: Devices
devicesParkAdmin.content: Manage ESP32 room display devices mounted outside meeting rooms. Monitor status, push over-the-air firmware updates to individual devices or all at once, and regenerate access tokens.

companies.title: Companies
companies.content: Create and manage the companies (tenants) that share your site. Set company-level two-factor authentication policy and assign users to the correct company.

companiesParkAdmin.title: Companies
companiesParkAdmin.content: Create and manage the companies (tenants) that share your site. Set per-company two-factor authentication policy and control which users belong to which company.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.content: Analytics for your site: room utilization percentages, peak booking hours, daily booking trends, amenity popularity, and top-booker rankings. Filter by custom date ranges.

statisticsParkAdmin.title: Statistics
statisticsParkAdmin.content: Analytics for your site: room utilization percentages, hourly and daily booking trends, peak hours, amenity popularity, and top bookers. Useful for optimizing your space.

settings.title: Settings
settings.content: System-wide configuration: default booking hours, timezone, time format, two-factor authentication enforcement policy, and the system-wide announcement banner.

settingsParkAdmin.title: Settings
settingsParkAdmin.content: Configure default booking hours, timezone, time format, and two-factor authentication enforcement policy for your site.

parks.title: Parks
parks.content: Create and manage sites. Upload per-site logos, configure the visitor reception email and custom guest fields, and control whether iCal calendar feeds are enabled for a site.

userMenu.title: Account Menu
userMenu.content: Click here to open your account menu. Access personal settings (two-factor authentication, calendar feed subscriptions, password), or log out.

userMenuReceptionist.title: Account Settings
userMenuReceptionist.content: Click here to access your personal account settings — two-factor authentication, calendar feed subscriptions, or log out.

userMenuUser.title: Account Settings
userMenuUser.content: Click here to access your personal account settings — set up two-factor authentication, generate calendar feed subscription URLs, change your password, or log out.

ldap.title: LDAP Settings
ldap.content: Connect your company's LDAP directory to automatically sync users and map LDAP groups to application roles. Configure sync intervals and run manual syncs from here.

sso.title: SSO Settings
sso.content: Enable Single Sign-On so your team logs in with their existing corporate credentials. Supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) and SAML 2.0 — compatible with Keycloak, Azure AD, Okta, ADFS, and more.

reception.title: Guest Management
reception.content: Your main dashboard as a receptionist. See every expected visitor for today, check guests in when they arrive, and mark them out when they leave. Overstay alerts highlight guests still on-site past their meeting's end time.
